abilities.title: Frost Grenade
abilities.info: Throws a frost grenade that freezes up to five enemies for 2 seconds in an explosion radius of 6.

abilities.title: Toggle Reverse
abilities.info: Flies the opposite direction.

abilities.title: Ubercharge
abilities.info: Assigned towers gain a Damage Buff, Stun and Freeze Immunity.

abilities.title: Sweeper
abilities.info: Stops all normal attacks and unleashes two map-wide lasers on the map. These take a specific laser duration to move around the map, with each laser dealing damage once to any enemy it hits, effectively resulting in an enemy being damaged twice by this ability.

abilities.title: Airstrike
abilities.info: Drops bombs on a selected path location, damaging any enemies within the bombs' explosion radius. A red marker will appear on the location of the path selected, and bombs will drop when the marker is clicked.

abilities.title: Call to Arms
abilities.info: Boosts all towers' firerate in its range by a variable amount for 10 seconds. Additionally, the Commander will be able to attack enemies with its own weapon for 10 seconds.

abilities.title: Support Caravan
abilities.info: Summons two Gunner APCs and one Missile APC. Additionally, the Commander will be able to attack enemies with its own weapon for 10 seconds.

Cowboy.immune: Partial Debuff (Spring Time & Mecha Bunny only) Partial Stun (Spring Time & Mecha Bunny only)

DJ Booth.immune: Partial Debuff (Ducky only) Partial Stun (Ducky only)

abilities.title: Aggressive Toxins
abilities.info: Throws a grenade at the selected area, applying Neuralyzed to them. This forces them to be targeted by towers while also boosting how much damage they receive.

abilities.title: Patrol

abilities.title: Air-Drop
abilities.info: Drops the Mercenary Base's units on a selected area on the path.

abilities.title: Reposition
abilities.info: Leaps to the selected area on the map, changing its placement spot. Additionally, the Brawler will knockback to up to 20 enemies on its landing position with a knockback force of 25 within 7.5 reposition range at Level 3 (10 at Level 4), and will deal area damage in that range.

abilities.title: Raise the Dead
abilities.info: Destroys all its graves, summoning units based on the gravestone level.

Engineer.immune: Stun (Level 5+, units with shield only) Debuff (Units only)

abilities.title: Hologram Tower
abilities.info: Clones a tower after the drone has selected via the ability. Cost varies based on the total cost of the tower and the Hacker's Level.

abilities.title: Helicopter Reposition
abilities.info: Moves one player owned tower from one spot on the map to another. Cannot relocate the Farm, Pursuit, Ace Pilot or Gatling Gun.

abilities.title: SWAT Van
abilities.info: Summons in a Swat Van which collides with enemies and explodes upon death. With upgrades, replaces it with Swat Van Gunner which also fires at enemies. Number of units spawned depends on the upgrade.

abilities.title: Bounty
abilities.info: Places a hit order on an enemy in range, making Kingpin stop attacking enemies for 2 seconds. When that enemy is killed, a bonus reward is given which is a specific percentage of the enemy's total cash reward. The reward from this ability cannot go above a specific limit.

Golden Cowboy.immune: Partial Debuff (Spring Time & Mecha Bunny only) Partial Stun (Spring Time & Mecha Bunny only)

abilities.title: War Cry
abilities.info: Decreases swingrate by 65% through the Firerate Buff while also removing any Fatigue Debuff or Scared Debuff on the tower. When activated, the Gladiator cannot attack enemies for a few seconds. Lasts for 15 seconds.

abilities.title: Missile
abilities.info: Fires out two and at Level 4 four missiles at selected area. Missile range is double of regular range. Reloads one missile per cooldown.

abilities.title: Bee Swarm Grenade
abilities.info: Throws a bee swarm grenade that deals area damage and inflicts the stinging effect on enemies that were hit by it, dealing damage over time. The explosion deals damage to Lead, bypasses defense and has no damage drop off.

Jester.immune: Partial Stun (The Beast & The Flea only)

abilities.title: Equip Bombs
abilities.info: Swaps out the current bomb type to the selected bomb type.

abilities.title: Thorns
abilities.info: On use, the selected area will produce thorns that deal damage and slow enemies. All Farms that are both in the range of the Harvester and the track also generate thorns with halved statistics through its Nature's Bond.

abilities.title: Heatwave
abilities.info: Creates a shockwave, which deals damage to enemies, knocks them back and sets them on fire.

abilities.title: Ice Turret
abilities.info: Creates an Ice Turret in the selected spot, which chills and freezes enemies.

abilities.title: Convoy
abilities.info: Deploys a convoy of Railgun Tanks at the exit. abilities.info: Ability carried over from the Gladiator as its statistics were copied for the Combatant. If this did anything is unknown, though it likely had no function.
